@@U02964@@
(To the audience.)

@@U02965@@
I’m running out of light and air up here.
Do you think you might accommodate me down there?

@@U02967@@
How presumptuous!
At a time of life when you're nothing,
when you don’ count,
to go on pretending you're somebody!
Life and blood are one and the same,
everything in life depends on it, and
where is it fresher and more vital,
where does it surge with primal force more
vigorously than in the body of youth?
It’s the source of all creativity:
new life out of life.
It’s a time when everything is on the move;
things get done; when the weak falter,
they're pushed aside, and the fit,
the vigorous, take their place.
While we have conquered half the world with ideas,
what have you done
but nod, ponder, dream, deliberate?
Plans, always plans!
No doubt about it,
age is a cold fever,
an ague of whims and impotent fantasies.
You've left thirty behind, you say?
You're as good as dead.
The best advice would be to kill you all off.

@@U02969@@
What could the Devil add to that?

@@U02971@@
If I don’t will it, the Devil doesn’t exist.

@@U02973@@
(Aside.)

@@U02974@@
The Devil will get you yet before too long.
translation:
@@U02964@@
（对观众。）

@@U02965@@
我这里的光线和空气都快用完了。
你认为你可以容纳我在那里吗？

@@U02967@@
多么放肆啊！
当你人生一无所有的时候，
当你不数数的时候，
继续假装你是某人！
生命与血液是一体的，
生活中的一切都取决于它，并且
哪里更新鲜更有活力，
哪里的元力更澎湃
比年轻时的身体更旺盛？
这是一切创造力的源泉：
生命中的新生命。
这是一个一切都在运转的时期；
事情完成了；当弱者动摇时，
他们被推到一边，而配合，
精力充沛的人，取代他们的位置。
虽然我们用思想征服了半个世界，
你做了什么
但点头、沉思、梦想、刻意？
计划，永远是计划！
毫无疑问，
年龄是感冒发烧，
一阵心血来潮和无力的幻想。
你说你已经落后了三十个人？
你就跟死了一样。
最好的建议就是把你们都杀掉。

@@U02969@@
魔鬼还能添加什么？

@@U02971@@
如果我不愿意，魔鬼就不存在。

@@U02973@@
（旁边。）

@@U02974@@
不久之后，魔鬼就会抓住你。
